name: Santa Ynez Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: The Santa Ynez Valley warms from Winkler Region I near the coast to Region III in the east.
Chardonnay is the most planted grape, and Pinot Noir is also important.
The warmer east suits Rhône and Bordeaux grapes.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA in Santa Barbara County, in an east-west corridor between the Santa Ynez and San Rafael Mountains. It is very cool near the coast and warmer inland.
